name: Heading
purpose: Display-family (font-display) semibold title for window titles (settings, trash), the filter panel title, the sheet headline (dialog or sheet title and its accessible name), the selection summary headline in the multi-select inspector, and the title-bar project pill. Always tone primary. Sources: A (Heading rows, sizes 13.5, 14, 15, 16) and B (folded sizes: 13.5 to 14 ties up, 15 to 16 ties up). Conflict resolved: the title-bar project pill is in A's Heading (span) and B's Text (display font). It is placed in Heading here, because the display family is Heading's job.
base: none (styled h1, h2, h3, p or span; not a Radix primitive).

values.when: 14px (1rem). settings window title and trash window title (A 13.5 folded up), filter panel title, title-bar project pill (14px semibold).
16px (1.143rem). sheet headline (A 15 folded up, text-pretty), selection summary headline (16px semibold).
one line with ellipsis: window titles, panel title, project pill.
wraps onto more lines with text-pretty: sheet headline.

props.name: as
props.description: Default h2. h1 for the settings window title and the trash window title (B folds A's div to h1). h2 for the sheet headline on web and for the selection summary (A says p; see open). p gives no heading role. span for the title-bar project pill (a trigger, kept out of the heading outline).

role: heading (level 1 to 3) when as is h1, h2 or h3. none for p and span.
keyboard: Not focusable. On desktop the settings and trash title bars are drag regions and take no keyboard focus. Dragging belongs to the title bar, not the text.
platform: Desktop: each sheet is its own window with no dimmed backdrop, so the sheet headline is that window title and renders as h1. The settings and trash titles sit in window title bars; the settings bar is a drag region. Trash drag behaviour is not recorded, so do not assume it drags. Web: no window title bars. The page or route title is the h1; a dialog title renders h2.
open: 1) Trash window title size: A says 13.5px (code text-[13.5px]; measured estimate about 14px, bold). B folds to 14px (sm). Font weight kept at semibold here. Confirm the size and weight. 2) Whether the trash title bar drags the window is not recorded. 3) Settings window title states (scrolled, recording) are window chrome; the catalogue does not say whether the text changes. 4) Conflict on the title-bar project pill owner: A Heading (span), B Text with font display. Merged to Heading. Span (no heading role) proposed because it is a trigger. Confirm. 5) Conflict on the selection summary element: A uses p (reference); B recommends h2 for landmark structure. Kept p pending confirmation. 6) Sheet headline size: A 15px, folded to 16px (md). Confirm.
